newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Swedish shares close lower, depressed by Astra.
newsitem.headline: Swedish shares close lower, depressed by Astra.

text.p: Swedish shares closed sharply lower on Friday as drugs major Astra tumbled on its half year report and profit takers appeared on the market that closed at an all time high on Thursday.
The Stockholm general index fell 1.48 percent to 3,228.26 after shares worth 5.80 billion crowns changed hands.
"The weakening dollar also dragged the market down," said one broker.
Astra fell 10.5 crowns to 142 crowns after posting a lower than expected pre-tax profit for the first six months. Analysts were particularly disappointed by operating profit and margins.
"The report was largely as expected but speculation beforehand had driven up the share price," said one broker. "People bought on expectations and sold on the report."
The drugs sector index fared the worst on the market, plunging 5.45 percent, with Pharmacia & Upjohn PNU.N cuaght up in the whirl and sliding 6.5 to 292.5 crowns.
Fellow market heavyweight telecoms group Ericsson LMEb.ST closed 7.5 crowns lower at 364, following the general market trend downwards.
After renewed activity in the property sector a rumour of several days proved true.

State-owned property group Vasakronan made a 773 million crown bid for Gotic GOTIb.ST offering 19.75 crowns per Gotic A share and 19 crowns for B-series share. Gotic rose 10.7 percent to 18.70 crowns.
